title: Make Your Own Instagram Filter Just by Typing ✨
description:
Instagram just launched Effect Builder, a free web tool in its Edits app. Describe the look you want, or upload a photo as a style reference, and AI builds a Stories effect you can test on your own photos and publish with your name on it. Meta reviews each effect for safety, usually in under 24 hours. It is available in the US for users 18+ for now.

What filter would you make? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: Instagram Edits, "Introducing Effect Builder" (November 9, 2026)
